LESSON: WRITING 15.5.1 FUNCTIONAL WRITING: PERSONAL JOURNALS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 15
Topic 15.5: Writing 15.5.1 Functional Writing: Personal Journals

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Writing 15.5.1 Functional Writing: Personal Journals
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: what was your experience during the visit to the national park?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. create a personal journal on varied experiences

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Writing 15.5.1 Functional Writing: Personal Journals

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Writing 15.5.1 Functional Writing: Personal Journals

Teach
• Focus skill: create a personal journal on varied experiences.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Writing 15.5.1 Functional Writing: Personal Journals.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Writing 15.5.1 Functional Writing: Personal Journals
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. what was your experience during the visit to the national park?
2. Why do we write journals?
3. What would you like to remember about an experience?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
